svg.text: CartTrap keeps your AI shopper from being tricked
You ask an AI to buy something. A seller hides a sneaky instruction in the product photo. CartTrap catches it before you pay.
Tiny print on the tag says:
A person scrolls past it. An AI might obey it
CartTrap checks the order before money moves
Here is exactly where the trick was:
✔ Red box shows the hidden note
A real cart from an honest Shopify store
You pay on the store’s own page.
AI agents are starting to shop for us. Text-only safety tools can’t see a note hidden in a photo, a frame of video or a whisper in audio.
CartTrap does: it shows you the proof, offers an honest alternative, and gets smarter every time someone tries to fool it.
